claim_ceiling: TF-IDF citation hybrids are the primary product mode for jurist navigation (JP ~0.78). Dense embeddings provide three complementary views at characterized minimal scales: (1) Citation Heritage at 21yr/137k (AUC 0.79-0.85, superior to TF-IDF 0.71-0.74), (2) Section Cross-Lingual for Sachverhalt/Dispositiv at 1K sample (blocked at full corpus pending section extraction), (3) Linear Hybrid Complement at 19yr/122k (PASS adversarial gates at w=0.3-0.4, JP 0.61-0.67, exploratory). No representation achieves the factory jurist preference target (0.7) under true OOS conditions (ceiling ~0.53). Fundamental two-mode tradeoff (legal relevance vs cross-lingual reach) confirmed at all scales 3yr-165k. Corpus lane resumption required for 174k completion (bge_/bger_ mapping, parquet 2022-2026, section extraction).
evidence_summary: Verified primary evidence across 11 result files: citation heritage (21yr AUC 0.8455, 22yr AUC 0.7922, 24yr AUC 0.7667 cp64, all >0.75 threshold); section cross-lingual 1K sample (Sachverhalt cp64 cross_lang=0.282>0.2 PASS, Dispositiv 0.150>0.1 PASS, Erwaegungen 0.094<0.1 FAIL); weight sweep 22yr (linear hybrids PASS both adversarial gates at w=0.3-0.4, cross-lang recall 0.160 vs TF-IDF 0.124); two-mode tradeoff reproduced at 8 scales; true OOS ceiling ~0.53 via v8 holdout; negative results accepted (dense FAIL jurist gate all scales, v18 hierarchy max purity 0.65, legal TF-IDF from bge_ FAILS adversarial, raw 768dim FAILS citation heritage at 24yr). Reproducibility confirmed: v14 independent rerun (seed 137) reproduces v13 linear_citation_concat (paired ΔJP 0.039, std 0.021 PASS); v13 5-fold CV stable (paired Δ 0.027, std 0.016). Data blockers explicitly acknowledged. No leakage detected. Prior audit repairs (baseline fix, citation role integration, overclustering gate) incorporated. Work honestly represents limitations and recommends no further same-question cycles.
